selection.complex_cadence: Research-backed correctness while material runtime application contract is absent.

new_special_cases.name: half MIN/MAX seed admission
new_special_cases.reason: Canonical half values; source WaveOp templates require finite 7bff/fbff. Infinity and singleton fixture cases fail without these seeds.

new_special_cases.name: half source MIN/MAX recipe flags
new_special_cases.reason: Canonical scalar/Multiple GenericAsm needs existing ordered source recipe; no numeric half MIN/MAX provider operation. Before proof rejects without admission.

self_review.input_shape: Valid canonical half scalar/vector and existing matrix reduction leaves, produced by hlsl.meta.slang overload specialization; no accidental representation or rebuilt syntax.
self_review.algorithms: Existing descending XOR reduction / ascending shuffle-up prefix and original-input scan with separate transmitted state are unchanged.
self_review.single_authority: Raw source seeds remain in the existing identity helper; shared isMinMax classification preserves integer admission.

limitations.trace: Six compile/assembly checks only; bindings/textures/LUT/input/oracle absent.
Arithmetic/bitwise, FP32 prefix semantics, ordinary aggregate shuffles and context policies unchanged.
